stomachLipo.heroDesc: Some belly fat remains stubborn even with consistent diet and exercise. Stomach liposuction is a surgeon-performed body contouring procedure designed to remove localized subcutaneous fat from the abdomen and refine the waistline with precise sculpting.
stomachLipo.whatDesc1: Stomach liposuction removes excess subcutaneous fat from the abdominal area to improve shape and contour. It is not a weight-loss procedure and does not treat visceral fat (fat around internal organs).
stomachLipo.whatDesc2: It is ideal for patients with stubborn belly fat pockets and reasonable skin elasticity.
stomachLipo.step3Desc: Tiny incisions (3–4mm) hidden in natural creases.
stomachLipo.step4Desc: Cannula-based fat removal with controlled sculpting for smoother contour.
stomachLipo.processNote: Removed fat cells do not regenerate, giving long-lasting contour improvement.
stomachLipo.resultsDesc3: Final abdominal contour settles as swelling resolves.
stomachLipo.benefit1Desc: Eliminates diet-resistant belly fat pockets effectively.
stomachLipo.benefit2Desc: Enhances definition and creates a better abdominal contour.
stomachLipo.benefit4Desc: Uses tiny incisions that heal discreetly.
stomachLipo.benefit5Desc: Permanent fat cell removal (with stable weight).
stomachLipo.benefit6Desc: Can be combined with flank liposuction for optimal shape.
stomachLipo.ideal4: Non-smoker or willing to stop temporarily
stomachLipo.notSuitable1: Significant loose skin or muscle separation is the main issue
stomachLipo.looseSkinTitle: Have loose skin or muscle laxity?
stomachLipo.looseSkinDesc: If loose skin or abdominal muscle laxity is present, a Tummy Tuck may be recommended instead.
stomachLipo.recDesc1: Compression garment, mild soreness, walking encouraged.
stomachLipo.recDesc2: Return to desk work for many patients.
stomachLipo.harvardDesc: Describes liposuction as a safe method to remove subcutaneous fat when performed by qualified surgeons.
stomachLipo.mayoDesc: Confirms liposuction permanently removes fat cells from targeted areas and results are best maintained with stable weight.
stomachLipo.pubmedDesc: Literature supports that Power-Assisted Liposuction can improve efficiency and contour uniformity with controlled technique.
stomachLipo.faqDesc: Get answers to common concerns about stomach liposuction
stomachLipo.faq1A: A surgical fat-removal procedure that contours the abdomen by removing excess subcutaneous fat.
stomachLipo.faq2A: Visible changes usually appear at 4–6 weeks, with final results at 3–6 months.
stomachLipo.faq3A: Long-lasting, because removed fat cells do not regenerate. Stable weight maintains contour.
stomachLipo.faq4Q: Does stomach liposuction remove loose skin?
stomachLipo.faq4A: No. It removes fat. If loose skin is significant, a tummy tuck may be more suitable.
stomachLipo.faq5A: Discomfort is usually mild to moderate and feels like muscle soreness. Medication helps.
stomachLipo.faq6A: When performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a proper medical facility, it is generally safe. Risks are explained during consultation.
stomachLipo.ctaTitle: Get a flatter abdomen with surgeon-performed stomach liposuction.
stomachLipo.ctaDesc: Dr. Soma combines medical precision, MicroAire PAL technology, and safety-first technique to deliver natural, long-lasting waistline refinement.
